clues: This town lies in the middle of Bulgaria, in a rich green valley along the river Stryama. It sits at the foot of the Balkan Mountains.
Wind that slides down the Balkan Mountains cools its warm summers. When winter comes, snow falls on the town and its valley.
The first capital of the Thracian kings once stood near this town. Experts shared news of its find in 2005.
This town is famed for its rose oil. The oil is used to make fine scents and perfumes.
A large monument and a museum here honour a hero born in this town. He first stirred his people to break free from Ottoman rule.
